title: ExitPlanMode PostToolUseFailure Schema
description: JSON Schema for ExitPlanMode tool PostToolUseFailure events.  The tool-specific fields predate the captured payloads and are unverified

prompt_id.description: UUID of the user prompt being processed; absent before the first prompt

permission_mode.description: default, plan, acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk or bypassPermissions

level.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max

agent_id.description: Present when the call is made inside a subagent

agent_type.description: Present inside a subagent, or in a session started with --agent
